SHIPPING_POLICY:
Last updated: November 1, 2026

This Shipping Policy describes how Zita's Art Studio prepares and ships orders placed through this online store.

Where we ship

At this time, checkout shipping destinations configured for this store are within the United States. If you need delivery outside the currently available destinations, contact info@zitasartstudio.com before ordering.

Artwork packaging

Original artworks are packed with care appropriate to the medium and size of the work. Packaging is intended to protect the artwork during normal carrier handling. Please retain packaging materials until you have inspected your order.

Processing and dispatch

Orders are prepared for shipment after payment is confirmed and the studio has verified the artwork or product is available. Processing and dispatch timing can vary with artwork size, packaging needs, and studio schedule. For timing questions on a specific order, email info@zitasartstudio.com.

Shipping rates and delivery estimates

Available shipping options and rates are calculated at checkout based on your address and the items in your order. Delivery estimates shown at checkout or by the carrier are estimates only and are not guarantees.

Tracking

When a tracking number is available from the carrier, we share it through the order confirmation or shipping notification email associated with your purchase.

Damage in transit

Please inspect your package promptly after delivery. If an artwork arrives damaged, contact info@zitasartstudio.com as soon as possible and include clear photographs of the packaging and the artwork. Do not discard damaged packaging until the studio has confirmed next steps.

Questions

For shipping questions before or after purchase, email info@zitasartstudio.com or use the Contact page.

REFUND_POLICY:
Last updated: November 1, 2026

Thank you for collecting work from Zita's Art Studio. This policy explains how we handle damaged shipments, incorrect items, and return or refund requests.

Contact us first

Please do not ship an artwork back without written confirmation from the studio. To start a return or refund conversation, email info@zitasartstudio.com with your order number and details.

Damaged shipments and incorrect items

Inspect your order promptly after delivery. If an item arrives damaged, defective, or incorrect, contact us as soon as possible and include clear photographs of the packaging and the artwork or product. We will review the issue and confirm next steps.

Original artworks

Most offerings on this store are original, one-of-a-kind paintings. Because each original is unique, return and refund eligibility for undamaged original artwork is confirmed by the studio on a case-by-case basis after you contact us. Additional return terms for originals may be clarified before launch.

Prints and other products

If prints or other non-original products are offered, return terms for those products will be confirmed by the studio when you contact us about your order, unless a product page states different terms.

Refund processing

If a refund is approved, it is issued to the original payment method after any required return is received and inspected. Timing depends on the payment provider.

Questions

Email info@zitasartstudio.com or use the Contact page.
